verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs reference ADP retirement accounts that employees can manage from the employee portal. They also say payroll can connect with retirement tools to reduce duplicate work, so a retirement offering tied to payroll is evidenced. However, nothing explicitly documents 401(k) plan setup or contributions syncing automatically each pay run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 401(k)/retirement plan setup within RUN, automatic per-payroll contribution sync, plan provider/type details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
